title: Prediction: transparent self-location is necessary and sufficient for a minimal self

statements.text: The proposal predicts that transparent spatiotemporal self-location is necessary and sufficient for a minimal experienced sense of selfhood. Cases of opaque self-location, such as fully lucid, opaque, bodiless dreams in which self-location is experienced as a construct, would test whether minimal selfhood is still present.
statements.falsification_criteria: A minimal sense of self persists when self-location is experienced as opaque representational content, or is absent when transparent self-location is present.

sources.quote: One empirical prediction the current proposal makes is that transparent spatiotemporal self-location is necessary and sufficient for bringing about a minimal, consciously experienced sense of selfhood.
